svg.title: What it said, what the trace shows
svg.desc: Linocut-style print: black ink with cut-out lines, one coral second colour. A traveller who has arrived says: web first, then file. The footprints in the snow go first to the cabin marked FILE, with the numbers 1 to 4 beside it, and only then on to the tower marked WEB: four file calls before the first web call. The answer was correct; the process claim was not. One observed case; the picture shows call order, not elapsed time.
